name: Rings scUSD
oneLiner: scUSD is Rings' wrapper minted from supported stablecoins routed through Veda BoringVault DeFi strategies; yield is activated by staking into stkscUSD.
collateral: Stablecoin deposits routed through Trevee (formerly Rings) / Veda BoringVault infrastructure into curated DeFi lending strategies (e.g. Aave, Morpho); supported collateral includes USDC, USDT, DAI, GHO, and Sonic USDC.e
pegMechanism: Users deposit supported stablecoins to mint scUSD and redeem scAssets after a documented cooldown period; yield is primarily activated by staking scUSD into stkscUSD rather than by holding liquid scUSD itself.

mintAuthority.summary: scUSD is a Veda BoringVault receipt token on both Ethereum and Sonic. Both chains share the same contract address (0xd3dce716) with authority() pointing to RolesAuthority 0x7d5f61, owned by TimelockController 0xFb6ec7 (86400s min delay), controlled by a 4/6 Veda/Paladin governance Safe.

controls.label: Veda/Paladin governance Safe (4/6, TimelockController proposer)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295183: getOwners() returned 6 signers, getThreshold() returned 4, getModulesPaginated() returned empty. This Safe is a PROPOSER on the TimelockController (0xFb6ec7CCBd77a42922a35D22A94fdF7fd54EE4BC, 86400s min delay) which owns the RolesAuthority (0x7D5f6108e23c0CB2cfD744E5c46f1aAfFc30A348) that gates all BoringVault role grants.

controls.label: Veda BoringVault Teller (scUSD share mint on deposit)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295183: Blockscout confirms this is a BoringVault contract; authority() returned RolesAuthority at 0x7D5f6108e23c0CB2cfD744E5c46f1aAfFc30A348. scUSD shares are minted on stablecoin deposit via a Teller; role grants for Teller/Solver/Queue are controlled through the TimelockController→RolesAuthority chain.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295183: scUSD BoringVault authority()=RolesAuthority 0x7D5f61; RolesAuthority.owner()=TimelockController 0xFb6ec7 (86400s); proposer=4/6 Safe 0xb77d74f0 (no modules). At Sonic block 73503133: same contract 0xd3dce716 confirmed as BoringVault (large bytecode); authority()=0x7D5f61...; RolesAuthority.owner()=TimelockController 0xFb6ec7cc. Governance chain identical on both chains: 4/6 Safe → 1d Timelock → RolesAuthority → BoringVault.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: scUSD is reviewed as a Sonic/Ethereum Rings asset whose architecture includes cross-chain components: underlying capital is bridged through the Sonic bridge and vault shares can be bridged through LayerZero. Because holder-facing supply can depend on bridge/vault-share routing, Pharos scores the route as external lock/mint.
